ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward and outward convexity (bowing) of the outer lobe edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly circular high-intensity (white) pixels on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
